title: Phone
description: A phone's screen time, from the App Usage connector (DigitalStats): per day and per group of apps, hands-on time against video, music, maps and the home screen, unlocks, when in the day and at night, and every app.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "screen_time" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "screen_time" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: category
list.label: Categories
list.description: The categories of apps every panel counts (all by default).
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "app_usage" WITH KEY = "category" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "app_usage" WITH KEY = "category" WHERE "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Per day, over the time range
Screen on
panels.description: How long the screen was on, per day: the phone's own figure, lock screen and calls included.

targets.query: SELECT mean("screen_on_s") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Hands-on
panels.description: Time in apps of the hands-on groups (feeds, messages, tools, the rest), per day: not a video or music playing, a map while driving, or the home screen.

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(social|communication|browsing|productivity|smart_home|health|shopping|finance|games|news|photos|system|other)$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("screen_on_s") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Watching & listening
panels.description: Time in video and audio apps, per day.

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(watching|listening)$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("screen_on_s") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Unlocks
panels.description: Times the phone was unlocked, per day (the screen woken and left locked is not one).

targets.query: SELECT mean("unlocks") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Hands-on per unlock
panels.description: Hands-on time divided by the unlocks: how long the phone stays in hand once picked up.

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(social|communication|browsing|productivity|smart_home|health|shopping|finance|games|news|photos|system|other)$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("unlocks") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: At night
panels.description: Time in apps between 22:00 and 06:00 (local time), per day, the home screen left out.

targets.query: SELECT sum("duration_s") FROM "app_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(watching|listening|social|communication|browsing|productivity|navigation|smart_home|health|shopping|finance|games|news|photos|system|other)$/ AND ("local_hour" >= 22 OR "local_hour" < 6) AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("screen_on_s") FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Time in apps per day, by group
panels.description: Hours in the foreground per day, stacked by group: the hands-on groups at the bottom, then a video or music playing, a map, and the home screen. The category filter above applies.

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Social, news & web" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(social|news|browsing)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Messages & calls" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(communication)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Work & tools" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(productivity|finance|system)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Home, health & other" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(smart_home|health|shopping|photos|games|other)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Watching & listening" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(watching|listening)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Maps" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(navigation)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "Home screen" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(launcher)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Screen on per day
panels.description: How long the screen was on, per day (the phone's own figure).

targets.query: SELECT sum("screen_on_s") / 3600 AS "Screen on" FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Unlocks per day
panels.description: Times the phone was unlocked, per day.

targets.query: SELECT sum("unlocks") AS "Unlocks" FROM "screen_time" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 AS "Home, health & other" FROM "app_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(smart_home|health|shopping|photos|games|other)$/ AND ("local_hour" >= 22 OR "local_hour" < 6) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 AS "Watching & listening" FROM "app_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(watching|listening)$/ AND ("local_hour" >= 22 OR "local_hour" < 6) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 AS "Maps" FROM "app_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND "category" =~ /^(navigation)$/ AND ("local_hour" >= 22 OR "local_hour" < 6) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Time by category
panels.description: Hours in the foreground over the time range, per category (Tributary's: app/connectors/app_usage_categories.py; yours in TRIBUTARY_APP_USAGE_CATEGORIES).

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "hours" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "category"

panels.title: Apps
panels.description: Every app used over the time range: its category, hours in the foreground, launches and minutes per launch. Sort by any column.

targets.query: SELECT sum("foreground_s") / 3600 AS "hours", sum("launches") AS "launches", sum("foreground_s") / sum("launches") / 60 AS "minutes per launch" FROM "app_usage" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "category" =~ /^${category:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "app", "category"
